review:
Killer Night is an 80s-style thriller slot from Pragmatic Play built around expanding wilds. Any wild that lands can stretch up or down to cover two to five positions and may carry a multiplier of up to 10x. When several wild multipliers are part of the same win, their values multiply together rather than add.

Three to five scatters award 10 to 20 free spins, and every wild becomes sticky for the whole round. A new wild landing directly above or below a sticky one merges with it, adding the two multipliers. A super scatter in the trigger starts super free spins, where at least three expanding wilds always land on the first spin. Published RTP is 96.52%. Best for players who like wild-driven bonuses.
